name: [📝Contracts] Own A Market
desc:
🛒 Welcome to Own a Market!

🔨 Build, upgrade, and manage your very own market from the ground up! Stock shelves, unlock new products, expand floors, and turn your small store into a big supermarket.

🔄️ Rebirth to goldify your products and make them more valuable!
🌟 Your Market generates money while you're offline!

❤️ Experiencing lag? Buy a FREE VIP servers!
💵 Join the group and like the game for FREE CASH and more updates! 

This game was inspired by Monkey Mart :)
